interpretation: The module-level grouping update contribution passed held-out causal validation. Test grouping: before 92.2%, unconstrained 85.9%, guided protection 92.2%, random protection 92.2%. Test join: unconstrained 100.0%, guided 100.0%, random 98.4%. Exact local weight preservation is verified; all retention and composition scores still determine whether this is useful assimilation. Current-checkpoint development gates passed: ['random']; historical-best gates passed: none. Causal guidance did not beat matched random protection on grouping accuracy. Fixed-input unconstrained repeats scored 55-60/64 grouping; the guided score falls within that observed range. The original-trainer verification repeat also passed the current-checkpoint gate. Audit status: passed with a reproducibility limit. The data do not establish a reliable benefit from guided module protection.
